title: Which question a byte comparison answers, and the witness that decides it
note: D-2026-101. RP1-RP18: the verdict and the backend identity -- unresolved never different, a witnessed backend's drift never excused, strict never answered off the reference, the profile applicable only to the corpus, closure, exemptions and lock it binds, and every part of the arithmetic path in the identity. RP19-RP22: the witness tool's generation-record binding and early strict check. RP23-RP25: the wrapper's measured closure. RP26-RP29: the checker's wiring -- strict by default, strict fails early, 'stale' only for witnessed drift, a supplied tree never inherits the verifier's identity.
